blocks.text: Welcome to the official website of Bishkek State University named after Academician K. Karasaev. I am sincerely glad that you are interested in our university.

Dear applicants! Today you are standing on the threshold of a new stage in your life. Ahead is your student years, a time of professional development and personal growth. A time that forms the foundation of your future. How you spend these years will determine your future life path. That is why it is so important to approach the choice of a university with special responsibility.

BSU is one of the most prestigious universities in the country, a recognized leader in higher education and science in the Kyrgyz Republic, having its own firm place not only in the national intellectual space, but also in the international sphere.
Today BSU named after K. Karasaev:

is a member of many authoritative international associations, such as the Eurasian Association of Universities, the SCO Consortium of Humanitarian Universities, the Union of Universities of Turkic-Speaking Countries, and the Association of Universities of Kyrgyzstan;
cooperates with more than 70 leading universities in the world, within the framework of annual internships (Germany, Russia, USA, China, Turkey, Japan, Korea, Great Britain and others);

The university offers more than 50 educational programs of secondary and higher vocational education in 16 languages (English, German, French, Persian, Arabic, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Italian, Polish and others).
The life of students at our university is full of bright events, seminars, conferences, full of creativity and scientific research, as well as meeting interesting people.
The BSU team sincerely hopes that the proposed list of specialties, their brief description and characteristics will help applicants make the right choice of their profession.
We are always open to new ideas, cooperation and development!
Welcome to BSU named after K. Karasaev!
BSU is a university for those who believe in themselves and strive for success!
Sincerely, Rector of BSU named after K. Karasaev, Dyldaev M.M.
